programme.title: Sevanthi
programme.desc: Sevanthi is daily family entertainment serial in Udaya TV. Arjun and Anuradha both are grandchildren of Pramoda Devi. The family is wanting the duo to get hitched and their closeness has generated such emotion in the hearts of family members. However, because of tragedy befell on family of Anuradha, She end up growing as Sevanthi at an Ashram (orphanage) run by Shantamurthy. The Ashram one day lands in trouble as Sakshi, hailing from an elite family conspires to take over. To safeguard the ashram, Sevanthi approaches Arjun. The popular advocate Arjun put pre-condition of contractual marriage with her, only if Sevanthi agrees to that, he says, he will protect the Ashram. What would happen if a boy who has no belief in relationship and love marries a girl who lives breathing love and care is the knot of the tale.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The forest ranger's house is the only area of human civilization in the middle of untamed wilderness in a vast natural reserve in Canada. When the ranger is away, a bear named Grizzy feels that the ranger's house is his territory, given that bears sit at the top of the food chain. After making his way inside the home, Grizzy takes advantage of all the modern conveniences there, including a comfortable sofa, air conditioning and fully equipped kitchen. He's not alone, though, because a group of small creatures called lemmings also populate the ranger's house when he is away. Because Grizzy and the lemmings are not civilized enough to live together in peace, it becomes an atmosphere of madness when the two sides try to outdo each other with tricks.
programme.sub-title: Grizzly, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house.

When the ranger is away, a bear named Grizzy feels that the ranger's house is his territory, given that bears sit at the top of the food chain. After making his way inside the home, Grizzy takes advantage of all the modern conveniences there, including a comfortable sofa, air conditioning and fully equipped kitchen. He's not alone, though, because a group of small creatures called lemmings also populate the ranger's house when he is away. Because Grizzy and the lemmings are not civilized enough to live together in peace, it becomes an atmosphere of madness when the two sides try to outdo each other with tricks.
programme.sub-title: Grizzly, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house.

programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: Cosmopolitan Cook
programme.desc: Acclaimed `food creative' and author Rachel Khoo leaves `The Little Paris Kitchen' behind and embarks on a culinary adventure to some of Europe's most exciting cities and towns. The goal is to be inspired by what she learns at each stop and translate new flavours and techniques into creating unforgettable dinner parties back home in London. Among other destinations and discoveries in the 10-episode series, Rachel visits the Catalonia coast to see how the locals cook seafood; investigates Scandinavian cuisine in Stockholm, Sweden; samples traditional pizza in Naples, Italy; and enjoys Spanish tapas, some chocolate treats, and delicious `Churros', a local favourite, in Barcelona, Spain.
programme.sub-title: Rachel takes a trip to Nice to explore the bustling markets. She makes confit cod with rainbow chard gratin and mini orange trifles with candied carrot.

programme.desc: With Majin Buu now defeated and Earth at peace, the heroes have settled into normal lives, which in Goku's case means being a radish farmer. They can't get too comfortable in their new lives because more evildoers are on the horizon. Enter Beerus, the powerful god of destruction, who awakens -- far away from Earth -- to a prophecy predicting his demise at the hands of an even more formidable being. His search for that being brings him to Earth, where he enters a battle against Goku and his friends. In order to save the world -- again -- they must defeat Beerus, their strongest opponent yet.

The wishes don't always go as smoothly as they plan, though -- after all, they're still in training -- and the girls must clean up the magical mess that results from the issues. When Shimmer, Shine and Leah work together they are able to solve the problems that arise and make things right. Trying to correct their mistakes helps to teach young viewers about learning from mistakes and doing better next time.

credits.actor: Eva Bella,Isabella Crovetti-Cramp,Dee Bradley Baker,Alina Foley,Blake Bertrand

programme.sub-title: Astronauts Leah and Zac are on a quest to speak to an alien. Shimmer and Shine send an alien right into her garden so she can talk to one face to face.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: A group of six rescue dogs, led by a tech-savvy boy named Ryder, has adventures in "PAW Patrol." The heroic pups, who believe "no job is too big, no pup is too small," work together to protect the community. Among the members of the group are firedog Marshall, police pup Chase, and fearless Skye. All of the animals have special skills, gadgets and vehicles that help them on their rescue missions. Whether rescuing a kitten or saving a train from a rockslide, the PAW Patrol is always up for the challenge while also making sure there's time for a game or a laugh.

programme.sub-title: Long-running children's series following the adventures, mishaps and friendships of Peppa Pig, her brother George, their parents, and the other animal families who make up their town. programme.title: Shimmer and Shine
programme.desc: Twins Shimmer and Shine are genies-in-training who grant wishes for their best friend, Leah. The wishes don't always go as smoothly as they plan, though -- after all, they're still in training -- and the girls must clean up the magical mess that results from the issues. When Shimmer, Shine and Leah work together they are able to solve the problems that arise and make things right. Trying to correct their mistakes helps to teach young viewers about learning from mistakes and doing better next time.

programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.desc: You won't hear the phrase "free shipping" uttered in this real-life series. programme.title: Shipping Wars
programme.desc: You won't hear the phrase "free shipping" uttered in this real-life series. It follows heavy-duty movers as they battle for the chance to transport items that traditional carriers won't touch, from bulky loads such as a Civil War cannon to bizarre items like a water buffalo. It's a high-stakes game, figuring out what shipments are worth the time and money to move them, but the bottom line is these haulers -- rookies and seasoned vets alike -- will deliver anything if the price is right.

The team has just three hours to shut down the lab's supercomputer and close the facility before the virus threatens to overrun the Earth.
programme.sub-title: Two associates of an elite commando team fight an army of zombies controlled by an evil desktop computer in a genetic research facility.

programme.desc: With Majin Buu now defeated and Earth at peace, the heroes have settled into normal lives, which in Goku's case means being a radish farmer. They can't get too comfortable in their new lives because more evildoers are on the horizon. Enter Beerus, the powerful god of destruction, who awakens -- far away from Earth -- to a prophecy predicting his demise at the hands of an even more formidable being. His search for that being brings him to Earth, where he enters a battle against Goku and his friends. In order to save the world -- again -- they must defeat Beerus, their strongest opponent yet.

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc: It's not that Steve Backshall has a death wish. Quite the opposite, actually. He lives for adventure, and his mission to come as close as possible to 60 of the world's most deadly animals is a brazen way to challenge himself. The naturalist and wildlife expert journeys to five continents and encounters a wide range of mammals, birds, reptiles and insects -- some familiar, others quite unusual -- including Baja rattlesnakes, tarantula hawk wasps, Humboldt squid, wolf eels and flesh-eating cockroaches. Backshall also tries to mimic the animals to see if he can match their lethal skills, such as hanging like a bat or flying down a zip wire to emulate a fish eagle.
programme.sub-title: Steve and the crew are in Peru, searching for elusive giant river otters. Later, he accidentally encounters the largest reptile in South America.

programme.title: Dora and Friends: Into the City!
programme.desc: Young viewers and parents familiar with Dora, Diego and the rest of the "Dora the Explorer" gang have new characters to learn about, as Dora heads to school in the city of Playa Verde. She works alongside her friends to give back to the community, while going on a variety of adventures. Her pals include artistic Kate, intelligent Naiya, musical Emma, athletic Alana and playful Pablo. Also helping Dora solve mysteries is new technology; rather than relying on a paper map, she now navigates the city using a map app on her smartphone, and overcomes obstacles with the aid of a magical charm bracelet.

credits.actor: Fátima Ptacek,Isabela Moner,Alexandria Suarez,Kayta Thomas,Ashley Earnest,Eduardo Aristizabal

programme.sub-title: Dora and her friends live in the city of Playa Verde, go to school and work together to give back to the community, while having a variety of adventures.

programme.desc: The daughter of a teen mother, Jane Villanueva grew up determined not to repeat her mom's mistakes. programme.sub-title: Survival instructor Cat Bigney and experimental archaeologist Bill Schindler journey into the jungles of Uganda in the footsteps of Homo erectus.

programme.title: Last of the Giants: Wild Fish
programme.desc: Cyril Chauquet and his team are dropped into the middle of the wildest environments on the planet with the sole mission of collecting vital specimens that could save species from extinction. After years of habitat destruction, pollution and commercial pressure, Chauquet and his team are on tight deadlines to make it through the dangerous, rugged terrain and back to civilization. The teams seek out some of the most endangered freshwater goliaths from the Great North of the Americas and the Amazon rainforest, including the armor-plated white sturgeon, the prehistoric pirarucu and the hulking piraiba.
programme.sub-title: Cyril and his crew search for the elusive short-tailed river stingray in Argentina.

programme.title: Snakes SOS: Goa's Wildest
programme.desc: Wildlife activists Benhail Antao and Louise Remedios team up to rescue venomous snakes in challenging situations across Goa, India.
programme.sub-title: Benhail Antao embarks on another adventure to rescue a checkered keelback, a massive cobra and another jumpy reptile all in a day!

programme.title: Tucci in Italy
programme.desc: Stanley Tucci believes that the best way to understand a country is through its food. Nowhere is this truer than in Italy, where the shape of your pasta and the sauce you serve it with speak directly to identity, and differentiate each region from the next. In this new series, Stanley's on a culinary quest to explore the connection between the food, the land and the people of the country he loves.
programme.sub-title: Famous actor Stanley Tucci explores Italy's culinary traditions, discovering hidden gems and untold stories with locals, chefs and artisans.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
programme.desc: Celebrity Chef Gordon Ramsay travels around the world to immerse himself into different cultures and cuisines. He then interacts with local chefs to learn and compete with them.
programme.sub-title: Renowned chef Gordon Ramsay enters the wilds of the Lone Star State and learns the meaning of the expression 'Texas Tough'.

programme.title: Dirty Rotten Survival
programme.desc: Outdoorsman Dave Canterbury, whose primitive skills were featured for two seasons on Discovery's "Dual Survival," is back in the reality show business, joined by jack-of-all-trades John Littlefield and engineer Dick Strawbridge for an adventure seasoned with grit, ingenuity, and a whole lot of "MacGyver'ing." The guys test their mettle by competing in location-inspired challenges across several states, with only a limited set of tools at their disposal. Canterbury's vast survival experience supplements the construction skills of Littlefield ("Dude Room," "Extreme Makeover: Home Edition") and the sustainability expertise of Strawbridge, a U.K. Army veteran well known for his popular BBC series "It's Not Easy Being Green."
programme.sub-title: The guys put their skills to the test as they try to navigate an old jeep through Louisiana's largest, most treacherous swamp.

programme.title: Primal Survivor Cutdowns
programme.desc: Wilderness and survival expert Hazen Audel takes treacherous paths in this documentary series. Using his knowledge and skills, Audel sets off on a journey via lesser traveled roads, where the terrain is unstable and the elements are often harsh and unpredictable. Stopping in local communities, Audel speaks to native residents to gather as much information about the area as possible. Following in the footsteps of the Embera tribe, the survival guide goes on a jungle trek through the Darien Gap. In other episodes, he navigates the Arctic Circle with 200 reindeer in tow and crosses crocodile-infested lakes.
programme.sub-title: Hazen Audel treks dense jungles, wild waters and towering waterfalls to summit Mount Gharat, where he joins Salkon tribesmen on a hunt to bring back a feast for the community.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded
programme.desc: An in-depth look at catastrophic events, analysing the science behind natural and man-made disasters and exploring the causes and consequences through expert insights and CGI visuals.
programme.sub-title: From evil hijackings to catastrophic malfunctions, explore some the worst transportation disasters that have strained the passage of time.

programme.title: Secrets of Penthouse
programme.desc: The filmmaker explores the extraordinary rise and fall of Bob Guccione, considered one of the wealthiest men in America at one time, who made millions with Penthouse magazine by taking on Playboy.
programme.sub-title: Penthouse's 1990s success propels Bob Guccione into risky ventures including cryogenics and an Atlantic City casino. Meanwhile, his son Nick's foray into video production ends abruptly.

programme.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
programme.desc: Host Dan Aykroyd uncovers some of the most mysterious and bizarre inventions, creatures, people and things throughout history, by using dynamic visuals, archival images, and expert interviews.

credits.actor: Dan Aykroyd,Adam Richman,Hakeem Oluseyi,Mitch Horowitz,Don Wildman,Martin K.A. Morgan

programme.sub-title: The filmmaker sheds light on peculiar places like a city where a zipline is required to commute, a town that is crawling with monkeys and a waterfall of blood.

programme.title: History's Greatest Heists With Pierce Brosnan
programme.desc: The filmmaker delves into history's greatest heists, uncovering the minds of criminals and strategies to pull off the dangerous crime.
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the Antwerp diamond heist and how the thieves executed their intricate plan after 27 months of planning.

programme.title: Shipping Wars
programme.desc: You won't hear the phrase "free shipping" uttered in this real-life series. It follows heavy-duty movers as they battle for the chance to transport items that traditional carriers won't touch, from bulky loads such as a Civil War cannon to bizarre items like a water buffalo. The competition begins each day when thousands of shipments are put up for auction online, and the truckers who make the lowest bids get the loads. It's a high-stakes game, figuring out what shipments are worth the time and money to move them, but the bottom line is these haulers -- rookies and seasoned vets alike -- will deliver anything if the price is right.

credits.actor: Marc Springer,Jennifer Brennan,Jarrett Joyce,Christopher Hanna,Robbie Welsh,Dusty Davie,Todd Sturgis,Tamera Sturgis,Jessica Samko

programme.sub-title: Marc is weighed down by a load that might just be more than the Boar can tackle. Meanwhile, Dusty gets stuck hauling some unique art sculptures.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: This series opens the doors to the only family-run pawnshop in Las Vegas, where three generations of the Harrison family use their sharp-eyed skills to assess what's real and what's fake. Objects the colorful customers bring in range from the obscure to the truly historic, and it's up to the guys at the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop -- with help at times from their network of experts -- to reveal the sometimes surprising answer to "What's this worth?"

credits.actor: Corey Harrison,Rick Harrison,Austin Chumlee Russell,Richard Harrison

programme.sub-title: Rick Harrison and his family own and run a pawn shop in Las Vegas. They purchase, sell and evaluate interesting artefacts with fascinating stories.

programme.title: American Restoration
programme.desc: A group of experts tries to restore American vintage items to their original state while facing a number of challenges during the job.
programme.sub-title: A unique quarter-scale model of 1932 Hudson car is brought to the shop. Meanwhile, a 1950s pillow speaker is brought for repair.

programme.title: Counting Cars
programme.desc: When Rick Harrison and the rest of the "Pawn Stars" gang need to restore a vehicle they're buying, they sometimes turn to Danny "The Count" Koker, who runs Las Vegas auto shop Count's Kustoms. The Count now gets his own half-hour show that showcases his ability to restore and customize classic rides. When he sees a vehicle he wants, whether it's at an auto auction or at a roadside diner, Koker does all he can to acquire it. When successful, he and his team then work to restore and modify the cars and motorcycles to quickly flip them for a profit. From classic cars like Thunderbirds and Corvettes to sidecar motorcycles and everything in between, if it has wheels, the Count's Kustoms team can make it look spectacular.
programme.sub-title: Danny inspects a collection featuring a 1993 Ford Roadster and 1953 Henry J. Later, Kevin, Ryan and Mike experience the strain of proving their unauthorized purchase's worth.

programme.title: The Food That Built America
programme.desc: The filmmaker gives a comprehensive insight into the history of American food culture, tracing the origin and development of famous dishes.
programme.sub-title: In the early 1900s, an underestimated confectioner makes the first-ever wrapped penny candy. At the same time, an unemployed salesman transforms a medicinal candy into a fruit-flavoured treat.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Investigators circle the globe in search of evidence in their quest to determine whether life on Earth began in outer space and if aliens influenced mankind in ancient times. Did extraterrestrial beings visit Earth and share information about technology and influence human religions? And more importantly, if aliens visited the planet before, will they return? Alien theorists believe that the answer to both questions is a resounding yes.

credits.actor: Robert Clotworthy,Giorgio A. Tsoukalos,Erich von Däniken,David Childress,William Henry,Linda Moulton Howe,David Wilcock,Jonathan Young,Jason Martell

programme.sub-title: Druids possibly used to travel to New England and New York's Hudson Valley centuries ago, bringing with them the beliefs and technologies of their alien mentors.

programme.title: Royal India with Samira
programme.desc: Renowned USA-based chef Samira Nanda explores the palaces of India in search of the culinary secrets of the nation's royal families.
programme.sub-title: Samira delves into the history of Udaipur, a city renowned for its grand palaces and ancient royal lineages. She also finds an opportunity to explore some of its culinary traditions.

programme.title: Omg! Yeh Mera India Classics
programme.desc: A compilation of the best episodes of 'OMG! Yeh Mera India', wherein the host sheds light on several inspiring and exciting stories from across India.

programme.title: Forged in Fire: Knife or Death
programme.desc: The country's most experienced martial artists, bladesmiths and knife experts stab, slice and chop their way through some of the most daunting obstacles they have ever seen. Competitors put their skills to the test as they slice through flying watermelons, hack through giant ice blocks, and slice various ropes, tubes, metals, and other objects. Blades that can be seen are America's historical Bowie knife, a Viking Seax, varying medieval swords, and traditional Japanese katanas. Each obstacle challenges the competitors to test the strength, durability and sharpness of their blades while also testing their own speed, precision and technique. The winner of each episode wins a cash prize and a coveted spot in the season finale. Once there, the winners have the chance to compete and win the title of Forged in Fire: Knife or Death Champion.
programme.sub-title: Bladesmiths put a 47-inch Iberian Montante blade, an English billhook and other weapons through a series of gruelling tests before the final two competitors go through the Dead Run.

programme.title: Life After People
programme.desc: On the heels of the History channel special that explored what Earth might be like if the human race were suddenly to disappear comes a series that provides, in even-more detail, a picture of a post-human future, revealing the fate of structures like the Sears Tower and the Sistine Chapel and creatures that might inherit the places we once lived. Supporting the visuals and special effects are interviews with specialists from the fields of engineering, botany, biology, geology and archaeology.
programme.sub-title: After humanity ceases to exist, the global retail machine collapses. Malls decay and shipping lanes turn deadly, while grocery stores become war zones for rodents and predators.

programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: With one quick click the internet allows people to share information like family photos and professional accomplishments, making it easy to ignore or forget that behind clever screen names and witty captions is a dark digital world with real dangers and risks. In hourlong episodes, Web of Lies unravels tragic stories of deception and manipulation triggered by online interactions, from predators lurking behind Facebook profiles to creeps scouring chat rooms for their victims. Re-enactments are buttressed by comments from law enforcement personnel, true-crime experts and psychologists, plus first-person accounts from friends and families of the victims.

programme.title: Blood Relatives
programme.desc: From the outside, families seem like harmonious units in loving homes. But you don't necessarily know what secrets families are hiding from the outside world. programme.desc: Featured on the Destination America series "Ghost Asylum," the Tennessee Wraith Chasers take their specter-hunting skills on the road to investigate America's most haunted towns. The team -- founder Chris Smith, co-founder Steven McDougal, historian Scott Porter, and trap inventor Brannon Smith -- travels to paranormal hotspots like Salem, Mass., Bisbee, Ariz., and Gettysburg, Pa., to interview witnesses and follow leads to try to pinpoint who is haunting the towns and why. Spooky stories in such places have been passed down through generations. Is it simply folklore, or is it true?

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked.
